name: Condluran
description: Condlurans were a sentient species that existed within the galaxy. The Condluran Briff worked as a smuggler on Jedha during the High Republic Era. During the Imperial Era, Freck was a Condluran male who worked as a transport driver for the Galactic Empire on the mining planet Mapuzo.

data.name: Condluran
data.distinctions: Snout with small tendrils protruding around it
